sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚那片区域的瞬间认出来，不管能不能看到路标，风景开始变得熟悉，我的

sentences.en: And I feel like, oh, this is what the world is supposed to look like.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，哦，这才是世界原本该有的样子。

sentences.en: that's a really nice artifact, I think, of having been raised someplace, of knowing where I'm from.
sentences.zh: 我想，这就是在某地长大、知道自己来自何处所带来的美好印记。

sentences.en: The Virginia Colony was part of the landscape of her childhood.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚收容所融入了她童年的风景中。

sentences.en: Molly says that when she and her
mother would drive past it on their way to shop in Lynchburg, she would press her nose to the window
sentences.zh: 母亲开车路过那里去林奇堡购物时，她就会把鼻子贴在车窗上

sentences.en: and stare at the red brick buildings.

sentences.zh: 它们看起来像闹鬼一样。

sentences.en: I knew that it had this complicated history
sentences.zh: 我知道它有着一段复杂的历史，

sentences.en: tangled up with Appalachia and the Great Depression and people with disabilities, and I knew that it was
sentences.zh: 与阿巴拉契亚山脉、大萧条以及残障人士纠缠在一起，我也知道它

sentences.en: still a residential facility for adults with really severe disabilities, but I didn't know
sentences.zh: 至今仍是一家收容重度残障成人的住院机构，但我对
除此之外的事情知之甚少。

sentences.en: In time, she learned about the institution's troubled history.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，她了解了这家机构饱受争议的历史。

sentences.en: For Molly, the story of Carrie and Doris Buck came with a special kind of pain.
sentences.zh: 对莫莉来说，凯莉和多里斯·巴克的故事带着一种特殊的痛苦。

sentences.en: own body, when she thought of the way strangers looked at her, she knew, deep down, the colony was
sentences.zh: 身体，每当她想到陌生人看她的目光时，她内心深处就知道，这个收容所

sentences.en: meant to house people just like her.
sentences.zh: 本来就是为了关押像她这样的人而建的。

sentences.en: I have impaired balance, and I walk
sentences.zh: 我的平衡能力受损，走路

sentences.en: with a kind of crouched gait.
Molly has lived all her life knowing
what it's like to be viewed, as Albert Priddy might say, as unfit.
sentences.zh: 那种被阿尔伯特·普里迪所说的不适任者来看待的感觉。

sentences.en: People would come up to my parents,
sentences.zh: 人们会走到我父母面前，

sentences.en: and they would say, what happened to her?
They would say, can she talk?
I think mostly those questions didn't come out of any kind of malice.
sentences.zh: 我想这些问题大多并非出于什么恶意。

sentences.en: They came out of discomfort and curiosity and a lack of understanding, but I understood because
sentences.zh: 它们源于不适、好奇和缺乏理解，但我明白了，因为诸如此类的事从我很小的时候起，

sentences.en: of things like that from a very early age, I understood my body as something strange and
sentences.zh: 我就把自己的身体理解为一种奇怪的、

sentences.en: othered and defective, and that people weren't encountering it in that way, and then assuming
sentences.zh: 被边缘化的、有缺陷的存在，而人们并不是那样看待它的，然后他们会

sentences.en: that I was othered and defective and strange.
sentences.zh: 假设我就是边缘化、有缺陷且怪异的。

sentences.en: once used to describe the residents of the colony.
sentences.zh: 用来描述收容所居民的词汇如此相似。

sentences.en: Molly felt the connection, and one summer,
sentences.zh: 莫莉感受到了这种联系，某年夏天，

sentences.en: when she was home on college break, she decided to visit the colony grounds.
sentences.zh: 当她大学放假回家时，她决定去收容所的旧址参观。

sentences.en: When I was there, I was just really struck by the place.
sentences.zh: 当我在那里时，那个地方真的深深触动了我。

sentences.en: I drove to the cemetery, you know,
sentences.zh: 我开车去了墓地，你知道的，

sentences.en: which had gravestones from the very early 1900s up to, you know, just a few years prior to when I was
sentences.zh: 那里的墓碑从20世纪初一直延续到，你知道的，就在我去那里的

sentences.en: And I drove through the facility itself, which, because it was built on an enormous amount
sentences.zh: 然后我开车穿过了机构本身，由于它建在占地极广的

sentences.en: of land, still had standing on it all of the buildings that were the original colony buildings
sentences.zh: 土地上，原有的收容所建筑依然耸立在那里，

sentences.en: that had just been sort of abandoned and moved out of.
And then beside them, there were these newer
sentences.zh: 而在它们旁边，则是那些较新的、

sentences.en: functional buildings that were the current facility.
sentences.zh: 作为当前机构运作的功能性建筑。

sentences.en: And that combination of this place,
which was both a functioning residential facility and also a kind of ghost town of everything that it
sentences.zh: 它既是一个运转中的住宅机构，也是它过去一切的某种鬼镇——

sentences.en: had been, was really evocative for me.
And there's a little plaque kind of at the entrance of the
sentences.zh: 在收容所的入口处有一个小牌子，

sentences.en: colony that talks a little bit about its history.
sentences.zh: 上面简要介绍了它的历史。

sentences.en: And again, standing in the cemetery, I just remember
sentences.zh: 再次站在墓地里，我只记得

sentences.en: thinking, oh, if I'd been born in the same part of the world, even six years earlier, like I might
sentences.zh: 当时在想，哦，如果我出生在世界的同一个地方，哪怕早六年，我

sentences.en: well have been a prime candidate to be a colony patient.
sentences.zh: 很可能就会成为收容所病人的首选候选人。

sentences.en: And that is a kind of amazing, that was an
sentences.zh: 这真是一种惊人的，那对我来说

sentences.en: Slowly, the idea for a book emerged, a book of poeMs. She called it
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，一本诗集的构思浮现了，她称之为

sentences.en: the Virginia Colony for Epileptics and Feeble-Minded.
sentences.zh: 《癫痫与智力低下者弗吉尼亚收容所》。

sentences.en: Here's Molly reading the first poem in the
sentences.zh: 这里是莫莉在朗读诗集中的第一首诗，

sentences.en: collection, inspired by those drives she took as a child.
sentences.zh: 灵感来自于她童年时经历的那些车程。

sentences.en: Whatever it is, home or hospital, graveyard or
sentences.zh: 无论它是什么，是家园还是医院、墓地还是

sentences.en: asylum, government facility or great tract of land slowly seeding itself back to dust, its church is a
sentences.zh: 收容所、政府机构还是慢慢化为尘土的大片土地，它的教堂是一个

sentences.en: low-slung brick box with a single window, a white piece of plywood labeled chapel, and a locked door.
sentences.zh: 低矮的红砖盒子，配有一扇窗户、一块写着“小教堂”的白色胶合板以及一扇紧闭的门。

sentences.en: Whatever it is, my mother and I ride along its red roads in February with the windows down.
sentences.zh: 无论它是什么，二月里，我和母亲摇下车窗，沿着它红色的道路行驶。

sentences.en: This place looks lived in, that one has stiff gray curtains in the window, a roof caving in.
sentences.zh: 这个地方看起来有人居住，那个地方的窗户上挂着僵硬的灰窗帘，屋顶正在坍塌。

sentences.en: We see a small group moving in the channel between one building and the next, bowing in an absent wind.
sentences.zh: 我们看到一小群人在一栋建筑和另一栋建筑之间的通道里移动，在萧瑟的风中鞠躬。

sentences.en: He's in a wheelchair, she is stumbling, pushing a pram from decades ago, coal black and wrong.
sentences.zh: 他坐在轮椅上，她步履蹒跚，推着一辆几十年前的婴儿车，漆黑而诡异。

sentences.en: There is no way it holds a baby.
sentences.zh: 那绝不可能装得下一个婴儿。

sentences.en: Behind them, a few more shuffling bodies in coats.
sentences.zh: 在他们身后，还有几个穿着大衣蹒跚的身影。

sentences.en: I am my own kind of damaged there, looking out the right-hand window.
sentences.zh: 我在那里也有我自己的残缺，望着右侧的车窗。

sentences.en: I am taking crooked notes about this place.
sentences.zh: 我正在歪歪扭扭地记录着这个地方。

sentences.en: It is the land where he is buried, the place she spent her whole life, the room where they
sentences.zh: 这里是他长眠的土地，是她度过一生的风雨之所，是他们

sentences.en: made it impossible for her to have children.
It is the colony where he did not learn to read, but did paint every single slat of fence
sentences.zh: 这是他没有学会阅读的收容所，但他把你能看到的每一根栅栏条

sentences.en: you see that shade of yellow.
sentences.zh: 都刷成了那种黄色的收容所。

sentences.en: The place she didn't want to leave when she finally could, because she'd lived there
sentences.zh: 这个地方在她终于可以离开时却不想离开，因为她已经在那里住了

sentences.en: fifty years, and couldn't drive a car, or remember the outside, or trust anyone to touch her gently.
sentences.zh: 五十年，不会开车，记不清外面的世界，也不信任任何人温柔地触碰她。

sentences.en: And by some accident of luck or grace, some window less than half a century wide,
sentences.zh: 凭着某种运气或恩典的巧合，某个不到半个世纪宽的窗口，

sentences.en: it is my backyard, but not what happened to my body.
sentences.zh: 这是我的后院，但不是我身体经历的事。

sentences.en: Most of the poems in Molly's collection are written from the point of view of patients,
sentences.zh: 莫莉诗集中的大部分诗作都是从病人的视角写的，

sentences.en: but a few are written in the voices of colony staff.
sentences.zh: 但也有少数几首是以收容所员工的声音写的。

sentences.en: In a section of the book called The Infirmary, Molly writes from the perspective of a colony doctor.
sentences.zh: 在书中名为《医务室》的部分中，莫莉从收容所医生的视角进行了写作。

sentences.en: It is shocking, really, how many ways a being can go wrong before they're even born into the world.
sentences.zh: 说实话，一个人在降生到世上之前就能出那么多岔子，真是令人震惊。

sentences.en: Cretanism, you are caught between human and animal, heavy and flat-faced.
sentences.zh: 呆小症，你介于人类和动物之间，身材笨重、面部扁平。

sentences.en: You have hoofs for hands, a cow's wide tongue.
sentences.zh: 你的双手如蹄，舌头像牛一样宽大。

sentences.en: Epilepsy, you are destroying yourself from the inside out.
sentences.zh: 癫痫，你正在从内到外地毁灭自己。

sentences.en: Feeble-mindedness, I could shout into the cavern of your mouth and hear my own words echo back
sentences.zh: 智力低下，我可以向你嘴巴的深渊大喊，听见自己的声音

sentences.en: off the high walls of your head, over all the blank space of your brain.
sentences.zh: 从你头颅的高墙上折射回来，掠过你大脑中所有的空白。

sentences.en: This is the most useful noise that you will ever make.
sentences.zh: 这是你能发出的最有用的噪音。

sentences.en: You cannot even reproduce my echo.
sentences.zh: 你甚至无法复现我的回声。

sentences.en: You are living, yet already your body has started to decay.
sentences.zh: 你虽然活着，但你的身体却已经开始腐烂。

sentences.en: It knows you are not for this world.
sentences.zh: 它知道你本不属于这个世界。

sentences.en: You go limp or spastic, turn to stone or slime.
sentences.zh: 你变得软弱无力或痉挛，变成石头或黏液。

sentences.en: At home, I drown the smallest kitten in the litter.
sentences.zh: 在家时，我淹死了窝里最小的那只小猫。

sentences.en: Hold its head under the water for a minute.
sentences.zh: 把它的头按在水下一分钟。

sentences.en: I feel its heart stop with my thumb.
sentences.zh: 我用大拇指感觉到它的心跳停止。

sentences.en: You are not for this world.
It would be cruel to let you replicate yourself and make another creature,
sentences.zh: 让你自我复制并创造另一个生物是残酷的，

sentences.en: fated to crawl around, feeble and stunted, yowling for absent milk.
sentences.zh: 那生物注定要四处爬行，虚弱而发育不全，为失去的母乳而号啕大哭。

sentences.en: I asked Molly why she wanted to feature the voices of colony staff.
sentences.zh: 我问莫莉为什么她想呈现收容所员工的声音。

sentences.en: It is easy from the present moment always to look back at what feel like the kind of atrocities
sentences.zh: 从当下回首那些感觉像是过去暴行

sentences.en: or injustices of our past and think, oh, okay, the people who perpetrated that were monstrous.
sentences.zh: 或不公的事情时，总是很容易觉得，哦，好吧，犯下那些罪行的人是极其残暴的。

sentences.en: They were nothing like my family.
sentences.zh: 他们一点也不像我的家人。

sentences.en: They belonged to a world that is entirely unlike the world around us.
sentences.zh: 他们属于一个与我们周围的世界完全不同的世界。

sentences.en: And to think, oh, we're at a comfortable, far removed distance from that time or from doing something like that.
sentences.zh: 并且觉得，哦，我们与那个时代或做那种事保持着舒适的、遥远的距离。

sentences.en: And I think one of the things I wanted to do by having poems in the voices of colony staff,
sentences.zh: 我想我加入收容所员工声音的诗歌，

sentences.en: of the doctors and religious leaders and nurses and attendants who work in this place,
sentences.zh: 即那些在当地工作的医生、宗教领袖、护士和护理人员的声音，其中一项目标

sentences.en: was to say, no, these people were in fact quite human.
sentences.zh: 就是想说，不，这些人其实非常有人性。

sentences.en: We're motivated by anxiety, by visceral disgust, by all kinds of things that we still feel.
sentences.zh: 我们受焦虑、受本能的厌恶，受各种我们至今仍能感觉到的情绪所驱动。

sentences.en: And that, in fact, this wasn't a sort of atrocity undertaken by monsters.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这并非某种由恶魔制造的暴行。

sentences.en: It was a campaign undertaken by deeply flawed human beings.
sentences.zh: 这是一场由充满缺陷的人类所进行的运动。

sentences.en: While campaigns of mass sterilization are in our past,
sentences.zh: 尽管大规模绝育运动已成过去，

sentences.en: the ideas that inspired those campaigns live on.
sentences.zh: 但启发这些运动的思想依然存在。

sentences.en: Dozens of women were sterilized without their consent in the California prison system

sentences.zh: 加州监狱系统中有数十名女性在未经同意的情况下被实施了绝育手术。

sentences.en: In 2017, a judge in Tennessee offered reduced jail time to inmates who agreed to be sterilized
sentences.zh: 2017年，田纳西州的一名法官向同意接受绝育手术的犯人提供减刑，

sentences.en: break a vicious cycle of repeat drug offenders with children.
sentences.zh: 是为了打破吸毒成瘾者不断生子并屡教不改的恶性循环。
优生学家是乌托邦主义者，

sentences.en: convinced that they were doing hard but necessary things.
sentences.zh: 他们坚信自己在做艰难但必要的事情。

sentences.en: As much as we might like to relegate their actions to the history books,
sentences.zh: 尽管我们可能很想把他们的行为归入历史书，
但重要的是要保持警惕，

sentences.en: to make sure we are not carrying their ideas with us in a new edition,
sentences.zh: 确保我们没有带着他们思想的新版本继续前行，

sentences.en: shining with the possibility of a brighter future.
sentences.zh: 闪烁着拥有更美好未来的可能。
